The deliverable must match the extended manifest, and the terminal update must reference the hashed root manifest.

Binding: freeze benchmarks before scoring; screen via /v1/retrieve before generation; change one axis per trial from a named prior; resolve every citation via /v1/chunks; record a cost vector for every trial.

Prohibited: any tenant mutation, ingest, collection lifecycle or graph extraction, admin routes, and the model benchmark endpoint. The token at /Users/me/.patric_token is never written, logged, echoed or returned.

Report bound_hit never as convergence, untested axes as not-tested, and sub-noise deltas as within-noise.

The directory holds every item in decision_ledger rev 5 d_deliverable_manifest, as extended by operator addendum d_manifest_extension: per-collection studies, run-level records, any checkpoint, and a root closure summary. A hashed root manifest lists every file, and the terminal update references it. A typed status alone would not be usable, because the value is the auditable per-collection, per-trial and per-question record.

fields.value: Determine, by measured read-only experiment against the BV-BRC RAGstack asm-next tenant, which retrieval and generation parameter combination and which episodic question-answering structure produce the best answers within each ASM paper collection measured separately, with the benchmark weighted toward multi-paper synthesis, leaving behind a per-collection winning configuration and the per-question evidence justifying it.

value.description: Host-normalized progress of the root task Episode, derived from its typed terminal update. It is coverage-weighted: the sum of per-collection scores c, divided by the number of readable ASM collections (expected 3). A collection WITH a verified result-bearing closure scores c = 0.5 + 0.25*A + 0.25*B. Such a closure is converged or bound_hit, with a frozen benchmark, a noise-floor record from at least 2 repeats, at least one scored generation trial with outcome rows, and a leaderboard naming a current best, all hash-verified. Every other collection scores c = 0. A is the fraction of applicable parameter axes with a scored generation trial, and B is the fraction of feasible standalone episode structures scored; both denominators are fixed exactly by the operator addendum. 1.0 means every collection was fully compared on both. Quality scores are never averaged across collections.

fields.value: A run-scoped directory under /Users/me/Development/OpenChia with, per readable ASM collection: the winning configuration as a runnable JSON profile (every parameter, episode structure, confirming model); a trial leaderboard (parameter vector, tuning synthesis completeness, document coverage, noise-floor verdict, cost vector); per-question outcome rows (answer, cited doc_ids and chunk_ids, verdict, failure class); the frozen benchmark with gold evidence sets and holdout split; the noise-floor record; baseline and winner holdout scores with the overfitting estimate; a findings note on axes that mattered beyond noise, did not, or were not tested. Run-level: API and inventory snapshots, size and graph table, cheap/strong model choice with reasoning, frozen judge prompt and hash, cost totals splitting tenant calls from Episode-side cost, and a cross-collection note comparing strata without averaging.

One per-collection study: take one readable ASM collection from reconnaissance to closure. Build and freeze its synthesis-weighted benchmark (at most 40 questions; low-power rules below 20 synthesis) and holdout split, and set its noise floor. Phase A screens retrieval axes on document coverage, gives every surviving parameter axis at least one generation trial, then continues until stagnation across distinct axes. Phase B scores each surviving episode structure on the phase-A winner. Then run tuning-set model confirmation and model-matched holdout scorings within the projected close-out budget. Close with one typed status and a reason, and write the findings note. The repeated sub-unit is one tuning-set configuration trial with use_graph set explicitly. Axes that moved a collection beyond its noise floor carry forward as ordering hints; a hint never skips an axis or changes required evidence.
